reason: Move transcript search trigger to existing chat, terminal companion and browser companion headers; closed search renders no row. Two exact production browser journeys across eight profiles cover header geometry and search accessibility, clipping, touch targets, close/reopen and refresh. Additional user-reported editor Files clipping: sidebar flex sizing constrains the scrolling list; one long-directory journey covers last-entry access, refresh, Files/Changes switching and desktop focus mode across eight profiles. No unit tests for CSS geometry. Two hook tests cover corrupt preferences, clamping and retention. Initial sidebar check reached the last entry but exact intersection ratio was 0.995 due to fractional border/scroll rounding; use 0.99 alongside explicit sidebar containment and successful activation. Rerun only these eight failed cases. Final review includes read-storage diagnostic classification and acceptance evidence only; rerun two width hook tests and build after that diagnostic fix.

Physical-device and manual screen-reader checks unavailable. Component runtime bounded to five minutes, browser run ten minutes, production build ten minutes.
